title: Plane carrying Maury Island slag explodes, killing two officers
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Plane carrying Maury Island slag explodes, killing two officers, about 1947 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> So, they get back on their plane and they're going to fly back to their base. Their plane explodes in midair.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, tells on Jesse Michels' podcast part of a 1947 story from Maury Island in Washington State, where men including one named Fred Crisman said they had pieces of slag, a rocky metal leftover, from a strange craft. Levenda says two military officers came to collect the material, and on the flight back to their base their plane exploded in midair, killing them. In the story, this makes the debris seem dangerous or worth hiding.
